sources.title: NOAA NCEI, Climate at a Glance: statewide annual average temperature, mean of 1991-2020 (converted from °F)
AEMET, valores climatológicos normales 1981-2010: annual mean temperature at a station of the regional capital
IPMA, Normais climatológicas 1991-2020: annual mean temperature at the station of the district capital
Tax Foundation, state income tax rates 2026: top state rate plus the 37% federal top rate (Washington taxes only capital gains, so none on wages)
Agencia Tributaria, Manual práctico de Renta 2025: top rate of the regional scale plus the 24.5% state top rate (common-regime communities only)
Autoridade Tributária, informação vinculativa 25858: national IRS rates cut by 30% in the Azores (DLR 2/99/A, art. 4), so 48% becomes 33.6%
Decreto Legislativo Regional 17/2026/M: IRS rate table for residents of Madeira in 2026, top rate 33.60%
U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, Regional Price Parities by state 2024: housing, as a percentage of the national level
Ministerio de Vivienda y Agenda Urbana, valor tasado de la vivienda libre, 2nd quarter of 2026: euros per m² in the community, as a percentage of Spain
INE Portugal, valor mediano das vendas de alojamentos familiares nos últimos 12 meses, 2nd quarter of 2026: euros per m² in the district capital, as a percentage of Portugal
U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, LAUS: state unemployment rate, mean of the 2025 months published (read through FRED)
INE España, Encuesta de Población Activa: unemployment rate by community, mean of the four quarters of 2025
INE Portugal, taxa de desemprego por NUTS II, 2025 (Algarve for Faro, and the two autonomous regions)

INE España, Censo anual de población, 1 January 2026: people born in Brazil, by community

IANA Time Zone Database: standard time of the region's main zone, hours from Brasília
